question: Is the most expensive model always the most accurate?
answer: No. The most expensive model, Gemini Flash-Lite ($225 per million complaints), scored 84.4% on customer labels and 95.4% on corrected labels. GPT-6 Luna cost less ($96 per million) and scored higher on both: 84.8% and 95.6%, respectively.
